title: Hardship Desk Program Sheet: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Extension Terms by Tier
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — extension figures by tier.**

| Tier | Installments satisfied before an extension | Max days past due | Max installments per request | Lifetime max installments deferred | Extension fee (USD) | Good-faith payment (percent of the monthly payment) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 12 | 45 | 1 | 2 | 35.00 | 50 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 9 | 45 | 1 | 3 | 35.00 | 50 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 9 | 59 | 1 | 3 | 25.00 | 25 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 6 | 59 | 2 | 4 | 25.00 | 0 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 6 | 59 | 2 | 5 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 6 | 59 | 2 | 6 | 0.00 | 0 |

In plain figures the extension fee runs 35, 35, 25, 25, 0 and 0 dollars from Tier 5 to Tier 1+.

Figures common to every tier:

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Minimum calendar months between two extensions | 12 |
| No extension when this many installments or fewer remain | 6 |
| Calendar days the customer has to complete the signed extension agreement before it expires | 10 |

## Notes on the sheet

- The extension fee figure is the tier's fee for one extension where the contract's state permits an extension fee.
- A good-faith percentage of 0 is the figure of Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+.
- The days-past-due figure is a ceiling that includes its own value: a Tier 3 contract 59 days past due is within it; one 60 days past due is not.
- The blackout figure includes its own value: with 6 installments remaining no extension is granted; with 7 remaining the blackout does not apply.
